title: MISP
description: Documented public threat sharing platform (CIRCL / EU (open source)) for the Threat Intelligence Aggregator capability area.
body:
MISP is a documented threat sharing platform from CIRCL / EU (open source). The open-source Malware Information Sharing Platform: structured IOC sharing among 6,000+ organizations.

How it works: It works by scoring each indicator on severity, confidence, and recency, ranking them and assigning block/monitor/log actions.

Documented uses of this capability area include supercomputer job scheduling, cryptographic migration planning, chaos-engineering programs, and disaster-recovery verification.
